checked_decisions.finding: Three-part shout continuing 1344-1345. 'I won't let you die' accepted: Tiffa is aboard the GX (1293-1294, 1313-1317, 1404) and the line reproduces the Gundam X scene where the omitted object is Tiffa. Leading 'And' is only a rhythm link; harmless.
chijou -> 'the surface', chikyuu -> 'the Earth': the source distinction is kept and both are correct.

Berkt is male in character_names_021 and his report is named in 1351; 'His report' in 1370 (yatsu no houkoku, spoken by the other Frost brother about the same report) is a settled referent, not an invented gender.
Gundam Ashtaron matches unit names; boku marks the younger Frost brother but no name was written in. Claws / transformation advice accurate.
'Too easy.' is an accurate rendering of tawai mo nai.
Kept open as the translator intended; 1370 (same enemy pilot, 'this machine') supports the enemy appraising the player machine.
'Kill them all, for all I care' + 'We only need to bring back that girl' together carry the source; commander untagged.
jama shinai! is the bare-negative command form ('no getting in the way!'), so the imperative is right; a self-directed 'we won't interfere' is not a natural reading after 'Move, move, move!'.
Tiffa Adill matches the glossary (wiki title), not the 'Adil' variant.

1386 'They're coming' is fixed by the appositive 'companions...'. 1394 'It's coming!' accepted: it follows the Satellite System activation 1392-1393 and precedes the firing shout 1395, matching the anime beat where Tiffa announces the microwave; see uncertainties.
Fragment kept in 1390; 'losing to' in 1400 is the minimal completion of the omitted passive and the brothers' retreat in 1401-1402 confirms it.
Olba per glossary; niisan -> Brother; watashi/boku split between the brothers preserved in register.
color/book commands in source order. 1405 active voice keeps agent (that boy) and patient (Tiffa). 1407 'New Federation too' reflects the source mo.
GX-9900, 7th Space War, 15 years ago all preserved.
Jamil kanchou -> 'Captain Jamil' per orchestrator decision.
1426 answers with 'Faye, ...', so 1424-1425 are Faye to the captain; explicit watashitachi in 1424 licenses 'we' in 1425.

uncertainties.issue: Object of shinaseru is inferred (Tiffa). If the orchestrator wants zero inference, 'No one dies here!' is the neutral alternative.
Speaker untagged; content (Berkt's report, watashi register in 1398) suggests the elder Frost brother. Not written in.
Tag 'is it?' softens a flat taunt (mikakedaoshi mo ii tokoro = 'all show and nothing more'). Meaning intact, left as phrased.
doko no kitai = 'whose / where that machine is from'; 'whose machine' accepted.

If the in-game cutscene shows the Londo Bell arrival at this point rather than the microwave beam, this should read 'They're coming!'. Cannot be settled from text alone; row passed on the scene-order evidence.
Longest rows of the slice (post-mission window text, three source lines each); within 110 visible characters but wrapping should be checked in-game.
'New Federation' follows the project glossary rather than the wiki's 'New UNE'; centralized terminology issue, not changed here.
